name: Functions & Graphs
roadmap: Master the visual-algebraic connections of quadratic functions. Understand how parameters control the graph's anatomy, use the discriminant to predict intercepts, and apply transformations to shift and reflect parent functions.
roadmap_zh: 掌握二次函數的代數與圖像關聯。理解參數如何控制圖像結構，利用判別式預測截距，並應用變換來平移與反射基本函數。

concepts.name: The Quadratic Anatomy
concepts.key_takeaway: a controls opening direction (up if positive, down if negative). c is the y-intercept. The axis of symmetry is the line $x = -b/2a$.
concepts.key_takeaway_zh: a 控制開口方向（正數向上，負數向下）。c 是 y 軸截距。對稱軸是直線 $x = -b/2a$。

concepts.name: The Discriminant ($\Delta$)
concepts.key_takeaway: Relates strictly to graphical x-intercepts: $\Delta \gt 0$ (2 intercepts), $\Delta = 0$ (1 intercept), $\Delta \lt 0$ (0 intercepts).
concepts.key_takeaway_zh: 與圖像的 x 軸截距嚴格相關：$\Delta \gt 0$（2 個截距），$\Delta = 0$（1 個截距），$\Delta \lt 0$（0 個截距）。

concepts.name: Function Transformations
concepts.key_takeaway: f(x) + k shifts up/down. f(x - h) shifts left/right. -f(x) reflects across the x-axis.
concepts.key_takeaway_zh: f(x) + k 上下平移。f(x - h) 左右平移。-f(x) 沿 x 軸反射。
